evidence_items.finding: monthly cash deficit has persisted for 22 consecutive months since the equipment loan was taken — the practice consistently ends each month with less cash than it started
evidence_items.rationale: Persistent monthly cash deficit since loan was taken is the primary financial distress signal. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: monthly debt repayment of $8,400 represents 13.6% of average monthly revenue — the operating cash generated before the repayment has not been separately measured
evidence_items.rationale: Debt repayment as a proportion of revenue with no baseline pre-loan operating cash measurement is the structural intelligence gap. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: a personal guarantee was provided on the $280,000 equipment loan, creating personal financial exposure for the dentist-owner beyond the business
evidence_items.rationale: Personal guarantee creates urgency beyond business solvency. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: dental practice; annual revenue $740K; 4 staff; original loan $280,000; outstanding balance $238,000; monthly debt service $8,400; 22 months since loan taken; personal guarantee provided; two-week patient appointment waitlist
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. Loan balance to revenue ratio confirmed. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): patient volumes are strong with a two-week appointment waitlist
evidence_items.rationale: Patient demand is a misleading positive signal — it does not indicate that operating cash covers the loan repayment.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the new equipment has enabled more complex procedures to be offered
evidence_items.rationale: Expanded procedure capability is a misleading signal — additional revenue from new procedures has not been compared to the repayment cost.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): monthly revenue billings of approximately $62,000 appear healthy in isolation
evidence_items.rationale: Gross revenue appearing healthy is a misleading signal when debt service has not been separated from operating cash.
